scope: All six models, all 500 questions, both answer orders; pilot and full run
eligible: Completed API response persisted as invalid because no accepted verdict or truncated finish; no automatic retries for ambiguous/inflight transport states
request_invariance: Byte-identical model/system/user messages/temperature0/max_tokens16000; frozen official protocol unchanged
selection: First valid judgment; no retries based on winner, tie, or score
archives: Every superseded attempt is retained byte-for-byte in a contiguous predecessor chain; cost includes all attempts
budget: Same cumulative relay usage dispatch guard, including pilot and all retries
exhaustion: Stop as incomplete; do not drop question, fill tie, change prompt or increase token cap
reason: Declared before the first request: same uniform first-valid retry rule for every model and question; completed malformed outputs only.
